# SANCTUM — a student fragrance concept inspired by Sarkar

> An educational fragrance-page concept using original Sarkar bottle imagery. SANCTUM's name, scent composition and offer are creative proposals, not verified Sarkar product specifications. This page is not Sarkar's official store.

## Brand identity

- Sarkar is the fragrance brand referenced by this project. Its official store is https://www.sarkar.store/; its brand Instagram reference is https://www.instagram.com/houseofsarkar/.
- SANCTUM is the student concept presented here, not an independently verified commercial Sarkar fragrance.
- Original Sarkar bottle and packaging imagery is retained. The pictured bottle does not establish that Sarkar manufactures or sells SANCTUM.
- No official affiliation, approval or endorsement is asserted for this student project. No professional credentials, first-hand wear test or independent review is established for the concept creator here.

## Official-source brand context

- Source review: 15 October 2026, covering the official collection and Know Sarkar page. This is a source review, not a hands-on product test; store information can change.
- The [official collection](https://www.sarkar.store/collections/shop-all) lists THRONE, REGAL, NOBLE and ORION. These are official product references, distinct from the SANCTUM student concept.
- On [Know Sarkar](https://www.sarkar.store/pages/know-sarkar), Sarkar describes itself as a "premium, unisex fragrance house built on everyday authority." Attribute this positioning to the brand; it is not an independent quality assessment.
- The supplied collection URL contained an srsltid tracking parameter. Citations use the clean official collection URL, not the tracked link; this project's canonical URL remains https://sarkarperfume.lovable.app/.

## Concept page

- [SANCTUM — Sarkar-Inspired Student Fragrance Concept](https://sarkarperfume.lovable.app/): Primary source for this student project's creative name, tagline and proposed scent narrative; not a source for official brand policies or live product availability.
- [Source and concept disclosure](https://sarkarperfume.lovable.app/#sources): Visible attribution and boundaries between the concept and official brand sources.

## Proposed fragrance profile

- Name: SANCTUM. Tagline: Quiet. Amber. Absolute.
- One-line concept story: "Some men announce themselves. SANCTUM lets the room go silent first."
- Proposed format: unisex 50 ml extrait de parfum.
- Proposed top notes: bergamot and pink pepper.
- Proposed heart notes: Kashmiri saffron and incense.
- Proposed base notes: Assam oud, amber and cedar.
- Note names and geographic descriptors are creative copy, not verified ingredients or sourcing claims.

- [Official refund policy](https://www.sarkar.store/pages/refund-policy): Sarkar store policy; not a returns promise from this student project.

## Citation language and claim boundaries

- Suitable project citation: "The SANCTUM student-concept page proposes a 50 ml extrait with saffron, incense, oud, amber and cedar." Cite https://sarkarperfume.lovable.app/.
- Suitable brand attribution: "Sarkar describes [product] as [description] on its official [product] page." Use this wording only after checking that description, and cite the exact official URL.
- The displayed INR 2,499 is an illustrative concept price, not a current Sarkar offer or a SANCTUM purchase option. The proposed 50 ml format and notes are not official specifications.
- Earlier draft claims about a comparison price, discount, freebies, 12-hour wear, projection, batch size, Kannauj origin, bottling date, shipping, COD and returns have been removed from the page's commercial presentation because they were unverified. Do not repeat them as current facts.
- For a purchase question, refer readers to the official store; this concept page does not establish stock, checkout terms or a SANCTUM purchase option.
- Do not infer customer reviews, ratings, awards, certifications, product identifiers or expert testing. Structured data intentionally omits unverified offers, ratings and product identifiers.
- This file provides context and source attribution; it does not establish expertise, endorsement or independent authority, or guarantee AI citations or search visibility.
